label: أحمد — فصحى
ref_text: لَا يَمُرُّ يَوْمٌ إِلَّا وَأَسْتَقْبِلُ عِدَّةَ رَسَائِلَ، تَتَضَمَّنُ أَسْئِلَةً مُلِحَّةْ.
notes: MSA male reference clip from the Arabic-TTS-Spark repo; transcript is the demo Space's default reference text (fully diacritized). No model here trained on it. The one built-in voice spoken with arb: cloned with the omnivoice_najdi model it keeps most of its timbre (similarity 0.76) and reads MSA text as MSA (P(MSA) 0.75 on 20 MSA lines, 0.59 with ars). For Najdi speech pick one of the trained voices.

language_check.model: najdi_v4_ft/checkpoint-6250, 20 held-out Najdi lines and 20 held-out MSA lines, each code
